Maya (PM): quick heads up — last night's outage highlighted gaps in our fallback/routing spec. need a tight PRD addendum + runbook edits. scope discussion pls.

Jordan (Eng Runtime): agree. we saw KV cache invalidation on variant switch fail which caused cold-starts and token storms. we should codify fallback acceptance criteria and canary gates.

Lina (Eng SRE): oncall-bot recorded latency spike ~02:14 UTC, ~30m. root cause: model-variant fallback without prefix cache TTL.

oncall-bot: Incident alert: latency spike on prod-redwood-api at 02:14 UTC — auto-failover executed.

Ken (Eng Platform): proposal: add rollout guards — incremental capacity threshold, model-variant health check, and enforced prefix cache TTL on variant transitions.

Ravi (Customer Success): hit 3 paying customers during window. they request SLA guardrails + clear degraded-mode comms. acceptance criteria should include customer-facing rollback and postmortem timeline.

Priya (PM): sketch of acceptance criteria (short):
- fallback triggers only after >= 3% 5m error rate OR avg queue time > 250ms for 30s
- prefix cache invalidation TTL <= 10s when switching model variants
- canary rollout: start at 1% traffic, monitor error delta for 10m, auto-rollback on >5% error increase

Jordan (Eng Runtime): add perf budget: fallback p95 latency <= 450ms and burst capacity auto-kick >= 2x baseline throughput.

Alex (Design): will update status page and in-app banner copy. proposed banner: "We're running a reduced-capacity fallback to maintain availability. Performance may be degraded; we're working on recovery."

Priya (PM): PRD addendum + runbook snippet I propose:

```
PRD Addendum: Fallback & Rollout Safety
- Scope: model-variant fallbacks, cross-region failover, cache invalidation behavior
- Acceptance Criteria:
  * Fallback only triggers on predefined policy (error/queue/time thresholds)
  * Prefix cache TTL on variant switch <= 10s
  * Canary rollout at 1% traffic with 10m observation window
  * Auto-rollback if error rate increases >5% vs baseline
  * Telemetry: token-level lat/err, model-variant decision logs, rollout event ids
- Runbook checklist (post-detect):
  1) Confirm fallback policy triggered and note reason code
  2) Check prefix cache status: `redis-cli --latency` ; if stale, trigger cache-bust task
  3) If cache-bust fails, shift traffic to dedicated pool `pool:d-legacy-1`
  4) Start canary on 1% traffic, monitor p95/p99 and error delta
  5) If p95 > 450ms or error delta > 5%, auto-rollback and escalate to Eng Runtime oncall
```

Lina (Eng SRE): runbook checklist looks good. add explicit step: rotate KV namespace if invalidation reports > 3 consecutive failures, then fall back to dedicated pool. also ensure synthetic canary traffic is in place before rollout.

Ken (Eng Platform): also require that any rollout emits `rollout.decision_id` meta into traces and a model-variant transition event in metrics so we can slice by user/tenant.

Maya (PM): who can own drafting the PRD addendum and opening an RFC?

Jordan (Eng Runtime): i can own the addendum + RFC. will tag eng-sre + customer-success. aiming to open RFC by EOD tomorrow.

Ravi (Customer Success): i'll prep a brief customer comms template and a list of affected customers.

Priya (PM): i'll wire the addendum into PH-3427 (roadmap ticket) and add acceptance criteria there.

Jordan (Eng Runtime): creating RFC/PRD addendum now — placeholder link: https://rwd.internal/rfc/XXXX (will update)

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: 2026-03-21T09:00:00Z.

Maya (PM): thanks all — small focused edit, big impact on reliability. :thumbsup: 

Alex (Design): adding banner variants and icons, will share mocks in the RFC.

oncall-bot: Note: attach incident id INC-20260321-01 in RFC for traceability.

Jordan (Eng Runtime): will include post-incident logs and timeline in the RFC.

Priya (PM): deadline: RFC + runbook PR by 2026-03-22 EOD. owners: Jordan (RFC), Lina (runbook tests), Ravi (customer comms), Alex (banner).

Ravi (Customer Success): acknowledged.

Lina (Eng SRE): will schedule synthetic canary and an e2e test for prefix cache invalidation.

Jordan (Eng Runtime): tagged reviewers: @Lina @Ken @Priya @Ravi.

Maya (PM): great. closing loop here; expect draft in ~18hrs.

Everyone: :thumbsup:
